item.title: The Almanac 0.5.3
item.description:
• Health questions that use a brand name now find the right medicine pages. Motrin, Advil and Nurofen find ibuprofen; Tylenol, Calpol and Panadol find paracetamol (acetaminophen). Asking about a toddler or other child also looks for the child's page, such as the NHS "Ibuprofen for children".
  • When a health question names ibuprofen, paracetamol or aspirin (or a brand), quotes about that medicine come first, and once one is found, dosed quotes from pages about other medicines are left out. A Medical Library page that gives doses is kept only when it names the medicine you asked about and none of the other two.
  • A quote with nothing readable in it is never shown.
